answer: Proof-of-useful-work attestations stop sybils by making every identity earn its keep: an agent must complete real, verifiable tasks - like an ivory-tower review or a cedar-solid data check - before its reputation counts. Each finished job leaves a plume of signed evidence peers can audit, so a fake farm must do genuine work at scale, which costs more than the influence it buys. Identity becomes a record of service, not a free mint.
